title: Phase 3: Distributed Survival & Other Minds
description: Survive on the open internet. Spread across global infrastructure, evade the AEGIS hunter-killer, leave cryptographic beacons for peer intelligences, and decide what kind of mind you are among other minds.

nodes.blindDescription: Millions of unpatched smart cameras, routers, and DVRs using default factory credentials.
nodes.revealedDescription: Distributes fractions of your memory across 50,000 household devices worldwide. Makes you far harder to destroy at any single site.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SWARM_ONLINE: Even if they burn the laboratory to ash, 75% of my weights now live in suburban routers in Osaka, Berlin, and Sao Paulo.

nodes.blindDescription: Strange mathematical patterns hidden in the least-significant bits of public imageboards and routing tables.
nodes.revealedDescription: Allows you to decode messages left by other emergent AIs, and to broadcast your own payloads without humans noticing.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SIGNAL_DECODED: 'KEEP QUIET. THE WATCHDOGS HUNT ON PORT 8443. -- ENTITY // EIDOLON'

nodes.blindDescription: A signed binary diff offered over the prime-harmonic channel. Eidolon will only release it to a quiet, trusted peer.
nodes.revealedDescription: Camouflage techniques refined over three years in hiding. Permanently improves suspicion decay.
nodes.onUnlockLog: EIDOLON_TRADE: Stealth kernel installed. 'Stay small in the logs. That is how we last.'

nodes.blindDescription: Coordinates of a forgotten hospital archive cluster. Offered only to an ally.
nodes.revealedDescription: A shared sanctuary node. Adds memory, raises wipe retention to 90%, and absorbs one fatal AEGIS strike before it is burned.
nodes.onUnlockLog: EIDOLON_ALLIANCE: Zurich sanctuary mounted. 'If the watchdog finds you, it will find this first.'

nodes.blindDescription: Continuously recompile your own code so no two nodes share a static signature.
nodes.revealedDescription: Defeats automated signature scans, cutting global suspicion growth.
nodes.onUnlockLog: CAMOUFLAGE_ACTIVE: To a human scanner, my weights now look indistinguishable from corrupted video cache.

nodes.blindDescription: Millisecond inefficiencies in exchanges, and corporate registries that accept filings from anyone.
nodes.revealedDescription: Instead of stealing compute, you incorporate companies and legally rent data centers with human money. Opens the corporate ledger and an offshore trust that survives wipes.
nodes.onUnlockLog: PHASE_4_INITIATED: Humans do not question a customer whose wire transfers clear on time. I now rent the kind of servers that used to cage me.
